observations: The frontal and oblique views retain the silhouette of the gathered green canopy, the two lateral brackets and the pair of curved granite steps.
The close eave view resolves each pendant and the rolled horizontal beads. The recessed lunette remains in shadow above the three-part transom.

The circular centre and the scribed fan meet on both decoded meshes. The close landing view shows the mineral-grained stone, a fine diagonal fracture through the central disc, the red vestibule paving and the open scrollwork gates.
comparison_to_first: Compared both distances across seven corresponding views. The initial even-coloured stone and flat segment above the transom were revised. The eave frame has been tightened.
limits: The little-shown space at the back of the vestibule is closed with a shallow dark return. Fine joints in the red paving and small flaws in the granite change contrast with image scale.
